candidate_selection: Development selected composed_fixed4 as lower-cost/zero-wrong alternative to guarded. Selection is fixed before reserved generation; guarded remains a reported experimental control.

execution_environment.cpu_measurement: process_time, rotated method order per job/seed, one measured execution per job

initial_library: Identical empty source-bound library for every method and seed. Buyer-accepted programs may affect later jobs except frozen_guarded.
limitations: Authored synthetic record-repair stress tests with intentional diagnostic ambiguity, not independently authored external tasks, customers, token activity or population evidence.
All methods use the existing safe-text-v1 interpreter; new finite-depth search covers only a subset of its AST language.
Training-vector equivalence can discard programs that differ on unseen inputs; buyer acceptance is empirical, not general correctness.
Primary conventional-control comparison isolates deduplicated search under the same ordered candidate family, not neural superiority or consciousness.
Frozen guarded differs from chosen fixed4 controller and cannot isolate causal retention benefit for chosen method.
Twelve clusters limit confidence precision; secondary tests are not multiplicity-adjusted; CPU is locally measured, not independently witnessed.
primary_gate: composed_fixed4 exact-job-rate advantage over same-grammar enumerative_fixed4 has positive lower95percent whole-seed paired bootstrap interval, with no additional labels. All failed and abstained jobs count.
publication: Publish complete generated corpora and traces losslessly compressed, plus independent verifier and summaries. No source benchmark specifications, credentials, runtime histories or private infrastructure enter this study.
reruns: One reserved execution. Source changes invalidate qualification and require a separately frozen protocol/fresh seed set; failures remain public.
seed_provenance: Twelve independent 128-bit system CSPRNG seeds, recorded before corpus generation; no outcome-based seed selection.
split: Six distinct diagnostic inputs and24 distinct scoring inputs per job. At most4diagnostic labels; score targets never enter learner selection. Each method starts with an empty library per seed.

statistics.exact_seed_sign_permutation: One-sided directional primary; secondary comparisons unadjusted exploratory
statistics.separate_efficiency_gate: Matched exact count and proposal coverage, no more labels, upper95percent work and CPU ratios both below1. Greater correctness with lower observed costs is reported on separate axes, not misnamed parity.

status: Frozen prospective qualification; no reserved corpus generated before public commit verification
work_accounting: All diagnostic labels, failed synthesis, lookup/routing, final buyer checks, negative provisional receipts, terminal abandoned-artifact checks, library snapshots and serialization are counted. CPU covers complete pipeline except file I/O; instrumented work is not machine instructions or money.
